messages:
elaine: Quick prelaunch sync — we need a concise checklist for the gated webinar flow + URL ops before launch. Specifically: keyword-to-landing mapping, JSON-LD schema (webinar + FAQ), internal linking pulls from docs, canonical mapping, and redirects for promo URLs + lead routing to SFDC. Can someone own each?

priya: I can centralize the checklist. priority LPs: webinar sign-up, gated ebook, product announcement post. Primary keyword idea: 'low-latency LLM inference' (intent: production infra) + secondary: 'inference cost optimization'. Will align messaging. :thumbsup:

marco: I can take keyword mapping + schema. Recommendation: JSON-LD WebinarEvent on the LP, plus FAQPage schema for the registration Qs. Add breadcrumb and canonical link element. Also surface Search Console param handling for UTMs so duplicate URLs don't get indexed. I'll drop the mapping doc by EOD.

jun: Content ops here — I have the post draft + 3 CTAs. Will set canonical from blog -> LP. For internal linking, we should add contextual links from product overview and docs (runtime, batching pages). Short copy for hero and subhead coming.

dalia: Redirect strategy notes — we should use permanent redirects for promo URLs unless temporary. Example mapping we plan to implement on CDN / nginx: 
```
# map promo -> canonical LP
/location/promo-llm-2025 301 /product/inference-lp?utm=webinar
/blog/initial-launch 301 /product/inference-lp
/promo/old-ebook 302 /resources/ebook-inference (temporary during A/B)
```
Also recommend setting `Cache-Control: noindex` on preview/promo pages pre-launch. Will coordinate with eng on rollout.

priya: Quick note — prefer 301s for link equity unless we'll definitely revert. For A/B bucket pages, use 302 and remember to add canonical back to LP.

marco: Agreed. No hreflang needed for en-US only. I'll also add the new LPs to the XML sitemap and queue an index request post-launch. Add structured data tests in Rich Results tool.

elaine: Lead routing — form submissions should POST to /px/webhook and create SFDC leads with campaign=WEBINAR-MAY-25. Jun, can you confirm payload fields? Need: email, utm_source, keyword_id, landing_id, gdpr_consent.

jun: Yup. Sample payload I'll validate: 
```
{
  "email": "...",
  "utm_source": "linkedin",
  "keyword_id": "kw-llm-001",
  "landing_id": "lp-webinar-0525",
  "gdpr_consent": true
}
```
I'll add a test harness and share a Postman collection.

dalia: Note from infra — feature flag for gated flow flips at 10:00 PDT on launch day. We'll schedule cache purge for CDN and invalidate the promo redirect rules after 24h if needed. :rocket:

priya: Messaging iteration plan — we'll A/B test hero headline A: 'Real-time LLM inference at predictable cost' vs B: 'Production-grade latency for LLMs'. Track conversions and downstream lead quality. Set tracking via Optimizely and record `variant_id` in the webhook payload.

marco: Also add `WebinarEvent` JSON-LD and embed `FAQPage` JSON-LD for top 3 registration questions. I'll paste the snippet into the prelaunch doc and run it through the Structured Data Testing Tool.

elaine: Great. Action items: Marco — keyword + schema by EOD. Priya — finalize A/B plan + tracking. Jun — validate payload + Postman. Dalia — implement redirect mappings & feature flag schedule. Everyone — drop final checks into the prelaunch checklist doc by tomorrow 9:00am PT. I'll run a last pass then. /remind #marketing in 20h to review. :eyes:
